description:
Implement a 'Staff Picks' feature for the Urban Electronics store.

1. Add a boolean field labeled 'Staff Pick' (machine name: field_staff_pick) to the Product entity type (Default bundle).
2. Edit the products 'Sony WH-1000XM5 Wireless Headphones' and 'Logitech MX Master 3S Wireless Mouse' to check the 'Staff Pick' box. Ensure other products are NOT checked.
3. Create a Block View named 'Staff Picks' that lists products where 'Staff Pick' is true. Configure it to show the Product Title and Price, with a limit of 5 items.
4. Place this 'Staff Picks' block in the 'Sidebar' or 'Sidebar First' region so it appears on the homepage.

The site is available at http://localhost. Log in with admin / Admin1234!
